definitions: The fourth planet from the Sun in our solar system, known for its reddish appearance.
In Roman mythology, the god of war, son of Jupiter and Juno, and father of Romulus and Remus.
A brand of chocolate bar, typically consisting of nougat and caramel covered in milk chocolate.
examples: Scientists are searching for signs of life on Mars.
The ancient Romans worshipped Mars as a powerful deity.
He bought a Mars bar from the vending machine.
